events.name: Creative AI Video Lab
events.description: Welcome to the Creative AI Video Lab—a collaborative space for exploring how AI is transforming video creation. From generating scenes and developing concepts to editing, voice, sound, visual effects, and publishing, we’ll share practical workflows, useful tools, experiments, and lessons learned. Bring your ideas, current projects, and questions. Let’s turn ideas into videos—together.
